summary: Second slice of the browser-surface generalization (comms-30 / release-22): the generic restore policy for persistent and ephemeral profile tabs as a pure-JVM class in plugins/plugin-native-browser-surface. BrowserSessionPolicy decides which tabs, history entries and bookmarks a host may persist: ephemeral (private) tabs and their visits are never part of a snapshot or history; tabs/history accept bounded http(s) addresses without user info, whitespace or control characters, bookmarks https only; lists are bounded and de-duplicated; a restored record goes through the same rules; Clear data for a site removes that host and its subdomains.

contract.BrowserSessionPolicy: validUrl (http/https, host, no user info, <= 4096, no whitespace/control), validBookmark (https), validTabId [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,80}, title (controls to spaces, trimmed, <= 200). persistable/restore(tabs, history, current) -> Snapshot with ephemeral tabs dropped, invalid/duplicate rows dropped, MAX_TABS 8, MAX_HISTORY 100, current kept only when it names a kept tab; immutable lists. recordVisit(history, url, ephemeral) newest first, once, bounded; ephemeral or invalid visits leave history unchanged. belongsToSite/withoutSite (host is the site or a dot-subdomain). restoreBookmarks refuses a damaged record (too long, invalid, duplicate) with IllegalStateException; changeBookmark adds newest first or removes, MAX_BOOKMARKS 100.

hostKeeps: Tab views and profiles (persistent profile separate from the privileged host WebView; ephemeral profiles deleted on close and on cold start), the sealed Keystore storage and its JSON encoding, restore timing and UI. Uses java.net.URI, so a host whose platform parser accepts hosts java.net.URI rejects (for example with underscores) gets those rows dropped, never accepted.
applicationModel: Reference only (not materialized into .eliza/patched). Adds new files only; touches no file 0038, 0060 or 0062 changes and applies after them in series (also on a clean base). Alpha's BrowserSessionStore and BrowserBookmarks keep their equivalent logic until this lands upstream, Gradle includes :eliza-browser-surface from the patched tree (android/settings.gradle, owned by P01) and Alpha switches to these classes.
